༄༅/ /sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi spyi dang bye brag bde gshegs 'dus pa'i chos kyi byung tshul 'khrul med yid ches drug ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi spyi dang bye brag bde gshegs 'dus pa'i chos kyi byung tshul 'khrul med yid ches drug ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad spyi dang bye brag bde gshegs 'dus pa'i chos kyi byung tshul bshad pa 'khrul med yid ches drug ldan zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba kun gyi yab gyur kyang*// rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul gyis ni// rgyal ba'i mdzad pa rmad byung ba// rgyal sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud// gang gi rang bzhin gzod nas nyer zhi rnam kun mchog ldan thog ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang*// gang yang dmigs pa kun gyi mtha' spangs spros dang bral yang rnam pa sna tshogs longs spyod rdzogs// gang zhig 'gro blo'i snang ba mchog tu zhi dang khro gar sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar mkhan mchog /gang gi rang bzhin khrag 'thung 'bar ba brgyad kyi rnam rol rang snang cho 'phrul de la 'dud| |snga 'gyur kun gyi rtser gyur pa// sgrub pa bka' brgyad rgyud man ngag /chos kyi rnam grangs ji snyed pa// byung tshul 'khrul med 'di skad smra// de la 'dir sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad ces nyi zla ltar grags pa 'di dag gi chos kyi byung tshul gtam du gleng ba 'di la gnyis/ sgrub chen bka' brgyad ces dkyil 'khor chen po dgu lhan cig tu nyams su blang ba'i tshul lugs spyir bshad pa dang*/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa zhes grags pa'i byung tshul bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis so// dang po/ sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad ces grags pa 'di nyid byung ba'i tshul ni lnga ste/ rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud de rgyud rnams ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul/ rig 'dzin rigs pa'i brgyud de glegs bam la ji ltar bris pa'i tshul/ mkha' 'gro ma gtad rgya'i brgyud de ji ltar gnang ba'i tshul/ gang zag la snyan khung du brgyud de slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs la ji ltar bka' bab pa'i tshul dang lnga'o// dang po rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud de rgyud rnams ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul ni/

thog ma med pa'i dus ston pa'i yang ston par gyur pa/ yang ston bla na med pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyal po/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid/ bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po chos kyi sku skye ba med pa las yongs la khyab pa'i thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don la dgongs te/ gzugs kyi sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan par bzhengs te/ 'og min gyi gnas gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen po rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa der/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang dam pa thob par 'dod pa'i 'khor rnams dang*/ zhi khro rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems ma/ khro bo dang khro mor bcas pa rnams la dngos su dgongs/ ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya rnams la brgyud nas dgongs te rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi tshul zab pa las kyang ches zab pa rnams thugs kyi dpal be'u nas phyung*/ mgul gyi bum par 'grim/ ljags kyi dbang po la bkram/ dung gi tshems bar nas bton te/ chos nyid skye ba med pa'i sgra gzhom med nā da'i dbyangs kyis gsungs so// de'i tshul yang bcom ldan 'das skye ba med pa'i don chos sku mnyam pa chen po'i ngang du gnas la/ rigs kyi yum gyis zhus pa'i glus bskul bas gzugs kyi sku zhi ba chen po'i ston pa mchog gi skur bzhengs te/ nyid las mi gzhan pa'i 'khor dag pa gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa zhig sngon byung ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por rab tu byung nas/ thog mar zhi bas 'dul ba rnams kyi don du zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po rgyas pa rigs brgya/ 'bring bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis/ bsdus pa rigs lnga sogs blo dang 'tsham pa'i rang gzhan gyi don mtha' dag sgrub pa rnams legs par gsungs/ de rnams zhi bas mi thul bar khro bo'i gdul byar gyur pa rnams kyi don du ston
